proof_requests: Clear photo or video showing the exact machine(s) being sold together, with a handwritten note (today's date) beside them.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric, pedal and cord visible.
Photo of all included accessories and the original manual.
Close-up of brand/model/serial plate and any 'Made in Japan' marking.
Clarification on whether one, two, or three machines are included in this sale.
response.reason: The three photos show three distinct machines with different brand names, yet the seller describes a single 'industrial Japanese' machine, and all images carry a third-party dealer watermark, raising strong suspicion of stock photos or a mismatched listing rather than a genuine single item in hand.
